name: Shiiko Love ~Usugurai Heya no Naka de Shoujo o Model ni Eroge Seisaku~
original_name: 椎子ラブ ～薄暗い部屋の中で少女をモデルにエロゲ制作～
source:
It's your 30th birthday and you've yet to have a girlfriend. You often chat on 2chan about your problems and with Sachie a woman you knew from work. One day you're introduced to Shiiko, a beautiful 10 year old grade school girl. Before you know it, you're already having sex!

After Shiiko becomes your girlfriend you meet the Dream Guru who demands that you make something of your life or you'll die. He gives you a time limit of 15 days. You decide to make your own eroge and since Shiiko is your lover you ask her to be your model and she agrees!
translation:
今天是你30岁生日，但你还没有女朋友。你经常在2chan上谈论你的问题，并与你在工作中认识的一位女士Sachie聊天。有一天，你被介绍认识了Shiiko，一位美丽的10岁小学女孩。在你意识到之前，你已经发生性关系了！

志子成为你的女朋友后，你遇到了梦想大师，他要求你为自己的生活做出一些贡献，否则你就会死。他给你的期限是15天。你决定制作自己的工口游戏，由于Shiiko是你的情人，你要求她做你的模特，她同意了！
